color.note: Three themes. Light is the page default for the website. Dark is the black section theme on the website (hero, process, footer) and the CMS dark mode. Red is the brand band from the current site (black type on red) for one call-to-action band per page. Set data-theme on a section or on <html>; palette tokens never change per theme.

tokens.name: red-300
tokens.usage: Palette. Pressed state of the red button in Dark (black text on it 8.4:1).

tokens.name: red-400
tokens.usage: Palette. Red links and red text on Dark grounds (5.4:1 on concrete-900, 6.0:1 on concrete-950); hover fill of the Dark red button.

tokens.name: red-500
tokens.usage: Palette. THE brand red, from the logo and the current site. Logo, the Red section ground, large display words, step marks and riser lines. Black text on it 5.2:1. White text on it is only 4.0:1, so never put white body or button text on red-500.

tokens.name: red-600
tokens.usage: Palette. Primary button fill on Light grounds, with white text (5.3:1).

tokens.name: red-700
tokens.usage: Palette. Primary button hover on Light; red text and links on Light grounds (6.0:1 on concrete-50, 6.5:1 on white).

tokens.name: red-800
tokens.usage: Palette. Primary button pressed state on Light (white text 7.8:1).

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Palette. Cards, inputs and table rows on Light; text on red-600 buttons.

tokens.name: concrete-50
tokens.usage: Palette. Light page ground: fresh, dry concrete. Text colour on Dark grounds.

tokens.name: concrete-100
tokens.usage: Palette. Sunken fills on Light: table headers, tab rails, read-only fields, image placeholders.

tokens.name: concrete-200
tokens.usage: Palette. Hairlines and dividers on Light (decorative only, not for control borders).

tokens.name: concrete-300
tokens.usage: Palette. Secondary text on Dark grounds (8.0:1 or more).

tokens.name: concrete-400
tokens.usage: Palette. The brand concrete grey from the current site. Decorative fills, disabled icons and large type of 24px and up only: 3.3:1 on white, 3.0:1 on concrete-50, so never for body text or control borders.

tokens.name: concrete-500
tokens.usage: Palette. Control borders, placeholders and captions on Light (5.2:1 on concrete-50, 4.7:1 on concrete-100).

tokens.name: concrete-600
tokens.usage: Palette. Secondary text on Light grounds (6.9:1 or more).

tokens.name: concrete-700
tokens.usage: Palette. Hover fill of dark buttons; borders of raised panels in Dark.

tokens.name: concrete-800
tokens.usage: Palette. Sunken fills in Dark: inputs, table headers, tab rails.

tokens.name: concrete-900
tokens.usage: Palette. Cards, panels and the CMS sidebar in Dark.

tokens.name: concrete-950
tokens.usage: Palette. Primary text on Light; the Dark ground. Near-black, so photos and the logo's pure black still read as deepest.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Palette. The logo's black. Text and buttons on the Red ground (5.2:1).

tokens.name: teal-700
tokens.usage: Palette. Success text and icons on Light (6.3:1 on white). Teal, not grass green, so it never depends on red-green hue alone.

tokens.name: teal-300
tokens.usage: Palette. Success text and icons on Dark.

tokens.name: teal-50
tokens.usage: Palette. Success tint behind alerts and status badges on Light.

tokens.name: amber-700
tokens.usage: Palette. Warning text and icons on Light (5.9:1 on white).

tokens.name: amber-300
tokens.usage: Palette. Warning text and icons on Dark.

tokens.name: amber-50
tokens.usage: Palette. Warning tint on Light.

tokens.name: brick-700
tokens.usage: Palette. Error text, icons and error borders on Light (7.3:1 on white). Close to the brand red by nature, so an error always carries an icon and a sentence.

tokens.name: brick-300
tokens.usage: Palette. Error text and borders on Dark.

tokens.name: brick-50
tokens.usage: Palette. Error tint on Light.

tokens.name: blue-700
tokens.usage: Palette. Info text and icons on Light (8.2:1 on white).

tokens.name: blue-300
tokens.usage: Palette. Info text and icons on Dark.

tokens.name: blue-50
tokens.usage: Palette. Info tint on Light.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Section and page background. Every section paints it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, form cards, table rows, the CMS sidebar and top bar. Red sections hold no cards, so surface equals bg there.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs inside a surface, table headers, tab rails, image placeholders, code.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Toasts and tooltips: the opposite of the theme.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on bg, surface and surface-sunken (Light 16:1 or more, Dark 13.9:1 or more, Red 5.2:1).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text: lead paragraphs, descriptions, table meta. On bg, surface and surface-sunken (Light 6.9:1 or more, Dark 8.0:1 or more, Red 4.5:1).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, captions, timestamps. On bg, surface and surface-sunken (Light 4.7:1 or more, Dark 5.7:1 or more, Red 4.5:1).

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse and on ink-filled (secondary) buttons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: dividers, table row rules, card outlines. Not for controls.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that identify a control: inputs, checkboxes, outline buttons (3:1 or more on bg, surface and surface-sunken).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, checked checkboxes and switches, the active tab and nav marker.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: accent-press
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed (active) state.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent, accent-hover and accent-press (Light 5.3:1 or more, Dark 5.2:1 or more, Red 11:1 or more).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links and text buttons, always underlined in running text (Light 5.5:1 or more, Dark 4.8:1 or more, Red 5.2:1).

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Non-text brand marks: the step mark in eyebrows, riser rules, the active-row bar, dimension ticks (3:1 or more on bg and surface).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, so the ring always sits on the ground beside the control (17:1 Light, 17:1 Dark, 5.2:1 Red).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text, icons and the Gepubliceerd status (Light 5.5:1 or more, also on success-bg; Dark 6.8:1 or more).

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind success alerts and badges.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text, icons and the Gepland status (Light 5.1:1 or more, Dark 7.0:1 or more).

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind warning alerts and badges.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, error borders, destructive buttons (Light 6.0:1 or more, Dark 6.0:1 or more).

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind error alerts.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Info text and icons, the Concept status (Light 6.8:1 or more, Dark 5.9:1 or more).

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind info alerts and badges.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Darkening layer under text on photos (hero, project tiles).

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modals and the mobile menu.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: t-display
styles.usage: Hero statement only, once per page. Uppercase, Archivo at 75% width. 56px under 720px.

styles.name: t-h2
styles.usage: Sub-section titles, CTA band titles. Uppercase, 75% width. 34px under 720px.

styles.name: t-h3
styles.usage: Card and step titles, CMS page titles. Uppercase, 80% width. 26px under 720px.

styles.name: t-h4
styles.usage: Project titles in cards, modal titles, form card titles. Sentence case, normal width.

styles.name: t-h5
styles.usage: Accordion questions, panel titles in the CMS.

styles.name: t-h6
styles.usage: Small group titles: footer columns, form sections, table toolbars.

styles.name: t-lead
styles.sample: Wij bekisten uw betontrap ter plaatse, op maat van uw woning.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a section title, in ink-soft. 18px under 720px.

styles.name: t-body
styles.sample: Elke trap wordt ter plaatse bekist, gewapend en gestort, zodat hij precies past tussen vloer en verdieping.
styles.usage: Running text. Keep lines near 66 characters (measure).

styles.name: t-body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside running text, key values, contact lines.

styles.name: t-small
styles.usage: Card descriptions, form hints, footer text, table cells in the CMS.

styles.name: t-button
styles.usage: Buttons and tabs. Uppercase, 85% width. 13px in small buttons.

styles.name: t-label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, badges, table headers, footer column titles. Always uppercase.

styles.name: t-measure
styles.usage: Dimensions and specs: rise, going, number of steps, floor height. Tabular numerals, comma decimals, unit after a space.

styles.name: t-stat
styles.usage: Big counts on CMS dashboard cards. 75% width, tabular numerals. Only real figures.

spacing.note: 4px base, 8px rhythm. T-shirt names. Sections are space-5xl (desktop) or space-3xl (phone) top and bottom.

tokens.name: space-3xs
tokens.usage: Hairline offsets, the gap between a riser rule and its label.

tokens.name: space-2xs
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap in badges; checkbox label offset.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: eyebrow to title, label to input, icon to text in buttons.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Inner gaps in compact controls, table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Input padding, page gutter on phones, gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gutters, CMS content padding.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Large card padding, page margin on tablets.

tokens.name: space-2xl
tokens.usage: Section title to content; page margin on desktop.

tokens.name: space-3xl
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section; section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-4xl
tokens.usage: Section padding on tablets.

tokens.name: space-5xl
tokens.usage: Section padding top and bottom on desktop.

radius.note: Square and precise, like a formwork board. Nothing on the public site goes past radius-sm.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Photos, hero, section bands, the red CTA band, project cards.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, badges, checkboxes, tabs.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, dropdowns, toasts, modals, CMS tables.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Only round things: avatars, status dots, the switch track.

shadow.note: Borders first, shadows second. Only floating layers cast one.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Hover lift on cards and table rows.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Dropdowns, the sticky header once scrolled, the quote form card over a photo.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modals and toasts.

layout.note: 12 columns on desktop, 8 on tablet, 4 on phones.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width on the website (plus page margins).

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of running text.

tokens.name: grid-gutter
tokens.usage: Column gap on tablet and desktop (16px on phones).

tokens.name: page-margin
tokens.usage: Side margin on desktop (32px tablet, 16px phone).

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Website header height (64px under 720px).

tokens.name: cms-sidebar
tokens.usage: CMS sidebar width (72px collapsed, off-canvas under 1024px).

tokens.name: cms-topbar
tokens.usage: CMS top bar height.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs on the website (40px small, 56px large; 40px default in the CMS).

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: large phones.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: tablets, 8-column grid starts.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: desktop, 12-column grid and full nav start.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: container reaches its max width.

timing.note: Crisp, no bounce. Everything that moves respects prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: All hover, open and slide transitions.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Colour and border changes on hover and press.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Arrow nudges, accordion and menu open, switch thumb.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Photo zoom on project cards, modal and toast entry.
